messages.text:
is there a delivery timeline for batch one? just wondering if its weeks or months lol

Thank you for your time,
    -Justin

Hi Justin,

Weeks, not months. Your Magic Miner 40T on Shop···· ships from our warehouse on October 31, 2026, so about a week and a half out. That date came with the delay notice we sent on September 27, when the manufacturer upgraded the hardware, and it is the date your order carries now. Your Miner Duster and Power Kit ship in the same box.

You can follow the batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status . Dates there can shift a little as stock moves between warehouses, but that is the current one, and tracking goes to this email address the moment it leaves.

Happy to have sorted the price side out for you too. If you were pleased with how we handled it, a word on Trustpilot would mean a lot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com . You are also welcome in our Discord for product news and help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
